import os
from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace')
programs=work/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            for y,x in q:
                cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,cells))
    return out

def _l_info(cells):
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    s=set(cells)
    best=None
    for er in (r0,r1):
        for ec in (c0,c1):
            vr=1 if r1>er else -1
            hc=1 if c1>ec else -1
            vlen=abs(r1-r0)+1; hlen=abs(c1-c0)+1
            expected={(er+i*vr,ec) for i in range(vlen)} | {(er,ec+j*hc) for j in range(hlen)}
            if s==expected and vlen>=3 and hlen>=3:
                score=len(s)
                if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,(er,ec),vr,hc)
    return best

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(g,bg)
    ls=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        info=_l_info(cells)
        if info: ls.append((info[0],color,cells,info))
    if not ls: return g
    _,target,lcells,info=max(ls,key=lambda z:(z[0],len(z[2])))
    _,(er,ec),vr,hc=info
    totals=Counter()
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color!=target: totals[color]+=len(cells)
    if not totals: return g
    source=max(totals,key=lambda c:(totals[c],c))
    choices=[cells for color,cells in comps if color==source]
    # Pick the component in the quadrant opposite the two arms of the L.
    def rank(cells):
        cy=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); cx=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        dr=cy-er; dc=cx-ec
        # Opposite to the L arms: vertical arm sign is vr, horizontal arm sign hc.
        directional=max(0,-dr*vr)+max(0,-dc*hc)
        wrong=max(0,dr*vr)+max(0,dc*hc)
        return (directional-wrong, directional, len(cells), -abs(dr)-abs(dc))
    chosen=max(choices,key=rank)
    for r,c in chosen: g[r][c]=target
    return g
'''
path=programs/'task-c696f143.py'; path.write_text(source)
print(path)
